slot.brief: Find the domain of a function combining a square root with a rational expression; use a sign chart and interval union.

verdicts.working: Require (x^2-9)/(x-1) ≥ 0 and x ≠ 1. A sign check at −3, 1, and 3 gives [−3,1) ∪ [3,∞).

working:
$\dfrac{(x-3)(x+3)}{x-1}\ge 0$, with $x\ne1$. Critical points: $-3,1,3$. Sign chart gives $[-3,1)\cup[3,\infty)$.
